definitionZh: 设置“position”属性以更改分隔线的起始位置，以可用空间的百分比形式给出（默认为“50”）。要将其设置为像素，请使用“position-in-pixels”属性。
sourceDefinition: Set the `position` attribute to change the divider's starting position, given as a percentage of the available space (`50` by default). To set it in pixels instead, use the `position-in-pixels` attribute.
